description: Mark the always-present members of the Label definition as required. Forgejo's Swagger is generated from Go structs with no `required` lists at all, so a label's `id`, `name` and `color` type as optional even though they are plain struct members serialized on every response. Also, from organization/_definitions.json: Mark the always-present members of the organization-tag response definitions as required. Forgejo's Swagger is generated from Go structs with no `required` lists at all, so an organization's `id` and `username` and a team's `id` and `name` type as optional even though they are plain struct members serialized on every response. Descriptions, visibility and the permission-unit lists stay optional. Also, from user/_definitions.json: Mark the always-present members of the User definition as required. Forgejo's Swagger is generated from Go structs with no `required` lists at all, so a user's `id` and `login` type as optional even though they are plain struct members serialized on every response — including the `owner` nested in every repository.
